title: What the score hides: an audit of BixBench — code and study
description: Code and writeup for a reliability audit of BixBench, FutureHouse's bioinformatics-agent benchmark: 140 replicated agent runs, 3,900 replicated grading verdicts across three graders, and every answer key re-derived from the raw capsule data. Headline finding: most of what the benchmark scores as agent failure traces to the answer key or the question's wording rather than the agent — verified by re-deriving both the key and the agent's answer from the raw capsule data. Full agent trajectories are deposited in a companion Zenodo dataset record.
